mapper.select: SELECT remand_code, hx.oppo_code, con.contract_no, case when con.audit_time is not null then DATE_FORMAT(con.audit_time,'%Y/%m/%d %H:%i:%s') else DATE_FORMAT(con.create_time,'%Y/%m/%d %H:%i:%s') end remandContract FROM hx_project hx left join topp_opportunity oppo on hx.oppo_id = oppo.id_ left join topp_contract con on oppo.id_= con.project_id WHERE oppo.is_valid = 1 and con.is_valid =1 and remand_state <> '需求废弃'

select * from ( SELECT con.contract_no, con.contract_name, DATE_FORMAT(con.start_date,'%Y/%m/%d') startTime, DATE_FORMAT(con.end_date,'%Y/%m/%d') endTime FROM hx_project hx left join topp_opportunity oppo on hx.oppo_id = oppo.id_ left join topp_contract con on oppo.id_= con.project_id WHERE oppo.is_valid = 1 and con.is_valid =1 and remand_state <> '需求废弃' ) conn group by contract_no having startTime = max(startTime)
